Saves favorites (apps, contacts, weather places) and shadow heights as a JSON file in the Downloads/MiriquidiLauncher folder. It also contains the notes from Documents/MiriquidiNotes (only with access to all files, in plain text), the data of the Podcasts page (subscriptions, favorites, positions, played marks) and of the Markets page (holdings, selection, sources), also in plain text. Downloaded episodes, passwords and API keys are never backed up. QR codes contain none of this.
The file will then contain names and phone numbers in plain text.
Importing replaces the existing favorites with the contents of the file.

The existing favorites will be replaced by the contents of the selected file. Notes are only added; existing notes stay unchanged. Podcast and markets data in the file replace the existing data; downloaded episodes are kept.
